## Summary

<!-- What does this change do, and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactor / chore (no behavior change)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing behavior to change)
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes (unit + e2e)
- [ ] I followed the coding conventions in `CONTRIBUTING.md`
  (hot-reload safety, one file/one responsibility, no new runtime deps beyond
  `yaml` + pi-bundled packages, no upstream-project references in code/strings)
- [ ] Comments explain the *why*, not the *what*
- [ ] If I changed phase prompt text, I updated the e2e markers
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]` (if user-facing)
